# Permissions

<!-- generated by tools/gen_docs.py - do not edit by hand -->

The scanner is **read-only** and uses **Microsoft Graph application permissions only** (client-credentials sign-in).
Nothing else is needed: no Azure RBAC role, no Exchange or Defender permission, and no write permission of any kind.

## Grant these (then click *Grant admin consent*)

| Permission | Why | Checks that use it |
|---|---|---|
| `AccessReview.Read.All` | Access review definitions (guest and privileged-role reviews) | access_reviews |
| `Application.Read.All` | App registrations (secret and certificate expiry) and enterprise apps with their granted permissions | app_credentials, app_permissions, app_registration_risk, oauth_consent |
| `AuditLog.Read.All` | Authentication-method registration report, last-sign-in dates (the latter also needs Entra ID P1) and the sign-in log (legacy-protocol evidence) | break_glass, legacy_signins, mfa_registration, privileged_accounts, user_hygiene, user_staleness |
| `Directory.Read.All` | Tenant, domains, groups and group settings, licence SKUs, delegated-consent grants | app_permissions, break_glass, domains_check, dynamic_guest_group, group_creation, hybrid_sync, oauth_consent, password_protection, privileged_accounts, public_groups |
| `IdentityRiskyUser.Read.All` | Identity Protection risky users | risky_users |
| `Policy.Read.All` | Conditional Access policies, Security Defaults, authorization policy (guest, consent, tenant-creation settings), authentication methods policy, admin consent workflow, cross-tenant access defaults | auth_methods, auth_strengths, authenticator_settings, authorization_policy, break_glass, ca_quality, conditional_access, conditional_access_cis, cross_tenant_access, named_locations, partner_tenants |
| `Policy.Read.DeviceConfiguration` | Device settings (who can join devices, device limit, LAPS). Policy.Read.All does not cover this endpoint for application access | device_settings |
| `RoleManagement.Read.Directory` | Entra role definitions, assignments and PIM eligible assignments | break_glass, pim_usage, privileged_accounts, privileged_depth |
| `RoleManagementPolicy.Read.Directory` | PIM role settings (approval and MFA on activation) | pim_role_settings |
| `User.Read.All` | Users: licences, guest state, sync state, password flags, sign-in activity | break_glass, privileged_accounts, user_hygiene, user_staleness |

## Not readable with an application permission

* `/directory/onPremisesSynchronization` - Microsoft documents this as DELEGATED-only (Global Administrator); application permissions are not supported (onpremisesdirectorysynchronization-get). Password hash sync therefore cannot be checked by an unattended scan.

## Licences

* Conditional Access, sign-in activity, Identity Protection: Entra ID P1 / P2. Without them the affected checks report **SKIPPED**, never PASS.
* PIM role settings and access reviews: Entra ID P2 or Entra ID Governance.
